results.note: Herzog announced on Saturday evening 7 Nov (JPost 21:36 UTC; Al Jazeera citing the president's spokesperson) that Eisenkot will be given the mandate, and handed it to him at a ceremony on Sunday 8 Nov.
JPost and Ynet report that Eisenkot received the mandate from Herzog at an official ceremony at the President's Residence on Sunday 8 Nov.
Herzog chose Eisenkot, not Netanyahu (announced 7 Nov, ceremony 8 Nov).

CENTCOM confirmed only that it disabled a St. Kitts-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman on 7 Nov, a vessel that does not count; Reuters (8 Nov) says Iranian state TV did not confirm missile strikes on its territory after blasts on Qeshm, Tasnim claimed two missiles hit, and neither the US nor Iran commented; no US confirmation or two-outlet US-official report of a strike on Iranian territory was found.
The Air Force's morning summary on 8 Nov (Ukrinform, 08:17 Kyiv) says Russia launched 164 attack and decoy drones plus 3 Kh-59/69 missiles from 18:00 on 7 Nov; 164 is at least 150.

Umerov was named head of the delegation on 6 Nov, before the window, by David Arakhamia (a parliamentary faction head, not a qualifying source) and by presidential adviser Lytvyn ('no changes so far'); no qualifying on-the-record statement naming the head between 06:30 7 Nov and 23:59 8 Nov was found in Kyiv Independent, Interfax-Ukraine or Ukrinform.

The debate was broadcast with Kupka and Rakušan. ČTK reports Rakušan's call 'stáhněte ten návrh!' as said 'večer v ČT', not in the noon Nedělní debata, and the ČT24 debate report (https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/nedelni-debata-o-vyhrocene-situaci-ve-spolecnosti-379393) has no on-air withdrawal call by either man. The iVysílání recording was not reviewed.

Havlíček took part in the debate. In the ČT24 and ČTK reports he talks about media funding only to reject a separate meeting with the opposition ('běžné postupy'), and neither report has him naming a share of tax revenue as the funding model. The recording itself was not reviewed.
Neither the ČTK media-funding dossier (whose newest item is from 7 Nov 16:57) nor a web search found any new rector's or dean's leave for 10 Nov announced between 7 Nov 05:30 and 8 Nov 23:59.
The ČTK dossier and ČT24 have nothing in the window about a new strike alert or a further strike from Veřejnoprávně or the ČT/ČRo unions. The latest strike item is the end of the 3 Nov strike.

In the 8 Nov Nedělní debata, Havlíček was asked whether the sector tax would be extended to sectors such as banking. He answered vaguely ('Máme celou řadu dalších nástrojů a řešení. Budeme o tom jednat') and did not rule it out, which Rakušan then pointed out on air. I read this as 'not ruled out when asked about banks'; he never said 'banks' himself.

Havlíček only said the coalition would discuss further measures. The claim that banks are in Schillerová's proposal comes from a Hospodářské noviny report cited by ČTK on 9 Nov (https://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/koalice-probere-ruseni-poplatku-za-ct-a-cro-mozna-i-sektorove-dane/2899213), not from her own words. None of the three confirmed that banks will be covered.
The wahlrecht.de row dated 07.11.2026 for the INSA T-O-Mix poll (1,204 respondents, 02.11.–06.11.) shows AfD 29 % and CDU/CSU 19 %, a gap of 10 points.

Tagesschau (8 Nov, 21:05) reports Merz's Sunday announcement to the Präsidium dinner only 'nach Angaben aus CDU-Kreisen', and the criterion excludes such reports. No direct Merz quote was found in the window; the formal proposal and joint statement are set for Monday 9 Nov.
Vatican News reports that Leo XIV landed at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery in Buenos Aires at 16:33 on 8 Nov and that President Milei received him at the official welcome ceremony.

The published text of the 8 Nov Palacio Libertad address has neither 'Malvinas' nor 'Falkland'. The San Martín monument stop was a wreath and silence, and Vatican News reports of the day record no such words.

ČTK, ČT24 Prague pages, Seznam Zprávy and a web search found no on-the-record named statement about the third Prague partner first published between 7 Nov 05:30 and 8 Nov 23:59. The latest is Seznam Zprávy from 6 Nov, and the ČT24 report on Rakušan's 8 Nov debate does not mention Prague.
STAN and Spolu had not announced the third partner by 8 Nov 23:59. The announcement was planned for 10 or 11 Nov.

MoneyToday reports a partial strike that began at 00:00 on 6 Nov and was scheduled to last three weeks. MoneyToday theBio, Herald and SBS coverage up to Monday 9 Nov KST reports no end, suspension or wage agreement.

IEC chair Mosotho Moepya announced the final national results and declared the 2026 LGE at the National Results Operation Centre in Midrand on Sunday evening 8 Nov (SAnews 19:54 SAST; EWN same evening), inside the window.
At the 8 Nov national declaration the IEC announced the ANC received 30.76% of the vote nationwide (DA 24.64%, MK 9.76%); the IEC dashboard itself was not machine-readable.
The national declaration took place on the evening of 8 Nov and gave the ANC 30.76% nationwide, below 31.0%.

By decree No. 7203 dated Sat 7 Nov, President Alliana named Ariel Martínez Fernández Minister of the Interior, replacing interim Carlos Benítez; Martínez (a former Cartes-era minister) was not in Peña's cabinet on 6 Nov (Última Hora, HOY, ABC).
Alliana met Oscar Lovera on 7 Nov and confirmed him as Minister of Economy and Finance; no replacement was named by 8 Nov.

The BCP announced the start of FGD payments to a second group of ueno depositors (over G. 10 million up to G. 121.76 million, no debts, account elsewhere), reported by ABC Color at 04:57 on 7 Nov and La Nación; the communiqué's exact time is not stated, but no report before 01:30 on 7 Nov was found, so it was taken as inside the window.

All UKMTO reports published on 8 Nov concern incidents on 7 Nov. The Khasab tanker fire (UKMTO 199-26) occurred at 19:20 UTC on 7 Nov, which is 23:20 GST, just before the window. The bulk carrier/military forces incident east of Khor Fakkan was reported by Reuters/Arab News by 21:40-23:00 UTC on 7 Nov, matching CENTCOM's Saturday disabling of the M/V Huda. TASS says UKMTO dated the tanker incidents to 7 Nov. No UKMTO incident dated 8 Nov GST was found. ukmto.org refused scripted reading.

AP had Colom ahead by 2,574 votes at 5 p.m. Fri 6 Nov (Mississippi Free Press liveblog) and still by 2,574 on Mon 9 Nov (Yahoo, citing AP). His AP lead at 21:00 CST on 8 Nov is therefore taken as 2,574, above 2,010. That figure is inferred from these two reports rather than from a report timestamped at 21:00.

Alaska Public Media reports that the Division of Elections' next count update came on Monday 9 Nov. It took Peltola's lead from the 637 she held 'last week, in the days following the Nov. 3 election' to 2,517. No update is reported for 7-8 Nov. The Division's site was unreachable (TLS failure).

Agreporsai ended its nine-day blockade of San Antonio's extra-port depots on Fri 6 Nov after an 8% tariff deal (PortalPortuario, BioBioChile, 6 Nov). MundoMaritimo (9 Nov) reports the conflict ended, with logistics normalising and no re-imposition. The separate national truckers' call for 10 Nov does not count under the criterion.
